Du berätst in Kranken-, Lebens-, Vermögens- und Unternehmensversicherung und bietest massgeschneiderte Lösungen für Kundenbedürfnisse Durch gezieltes Cross- und Upselling baust du vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf und stärkst die Kundenbindung Die Gewinnung neuer Kundschaft – sei es durch Eigeninitiative oder Empfehlungen – gehört zu deinem Alltag Du organisierst und führst Beratungsgespräche, telefonisch oder persönlich, mit Engagement und Fingerspitzengefühl Auch die administrative Nachbearbeitung liegt in deinen Händen: Offerten erstellen, Termine verwalten und weitere
• Aufgaben erledigst du präzise und effizient

Groupe Mutuel is one of Switzerland's leading insurance groups, headquartered in Martigny (Valais). The company offers a wide range of insurance and pension products for individuals and businesses across Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione - Si consiglia in salute, vita, asset e assicurazione aziendale e offre soluzioni su misura per le esigenze del cliente - Attraverso mirato cross- e upselling si costruisce relazioni fidate e rafforzare la fidelizzazione del cliente - L'acquisizione di una nuova clientela – sia per propria iniziativa che per raccomandazioni – appartiene alla vostra vita quotidiana - Organizza e gestisce gruppi di consigli di consulenza, telefono o personale, con impegno L'azienda offre una vasta gamma di prodotti assicurativi e pensionistici per privati e imprese in tutta la Svizzera.
descriptionByLocale.en: Descrizione - You advise in health, life, asset and business insurance and offer tailor-made solutions for customer needs - Through targeted cross- and upselling you build trusted relationships and strengthen customer loyalty - The acquisition of new clientele – whether by own initiative or recommendations – belongs to your everyday life - You organize and manage groups of consulting tips, telephone or personal, with commitment The company offers a wide range of insurance and pension products for individuals and businesses across Switzerland.
